evidence.notes: Nested AND, OR, and NOT condition expressions execute against local Apex test data.
SOQL date and datetime literals filter local Date and DateTime fields.
CALENDAR_MONTH and CALENDAR_YEAR predicates execute against local Date fields.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLDateConditionExpressionTest { @isTest static void dateFormatsFunctionsAndConditionsRun() { Account target = new Account(Name = 'Target', AnnualRevenue = 100, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 2, 15), LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 2, 15, 12, 30, 0)); Account otherMonth = new Account(Name = 'March', AnnualRevenue = 250, RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 3, 1), LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 3, 1, 8, 0, 0)); Account noRevenue = new Account(Name = 'No Revenue', RenewalDate__c = Date.newInstance(2026, 2, 20), LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 2, 20, 0, 0, 0)); insert new List<Account>{ target, otherMonth, noRevenue }; List<Account> dateLiteralRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE RenewalDate__c = 2026-02-15'); System.assertEquals(1, dateLiteralRows.size()); System.assertEquals(target.Id, dateLiteralRows[0].Id); List<Account> dateTimeLiteralRows = Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE LastSeen__c = 2026-02-15T12:30:00Z'); System.assertEquals(1, dateTimeLiteralRows.size()); System.assertEquals(target.Id, dateTimeLiteralRows[0].Id); List<Account> dateFunctionRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE CALENDAR_MONTH(RenewalDate__c) = 2 AND CALENDAR_YEAR(RenewalDate__c) = 2026 ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals(2, dateFunctionRows.size()); System.assertEquals('No Revenue', dateFunctionRows[0].Name); System.assertEquals('Target', dateFunctionRows[1].Name); List<Account> conditionRows = Database.query('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE (AnnualRevenue = null OR AnnualRevenue <= 150) AND Name NOT LIKE \'March%\' ORDER BY Name'); System.assertEquals(2, conditionRows.size()); System.assertEquals('No Revenue', conditionRows[0].Name); System.assertEquals('Target', conditionRows[1].Name); } }
